claim: *Three distinct relations.* Correspondence tests agreement between representations; conformance tests an artifact against an independent obligation; acceptance asks whether the receiving environment will take the result. Evidence for one relation does not establish the others.

topology.description: Three unordered comparison bands; symmetric correspondence vs directed conformance and acceptance.

required_terms: Evidence for one relation does not establish the others.
bw_encoding: Black outlines and arrows; white nodes; sparse 3–7% gray groups. Every non-solid relation is locally labeled; no distinction depends on color.
redesign: Native semantic redraw; colors replaced by labeled relations and line conventions.
alt: Three stacked bands distinguish correspondence, conformance and acceptance. Correspondence links two internal representations in both directions. Conformance asks whether an artifact satisfies an independent obligation. Acceptance asks whether a receiving environment will take it. The three provide different evidence. The candidate uses black lines, white backgrounds and sparse gray; meaning does not depend on color.
